files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.Driving.GetLocoInfoCommand
files.Summary: The following command can be used to poll the status of a locomotive. At the same time, the client also "subscribes" to the locomotive information for this locomotive address (only in combination with , Flag ).

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.Driving.PurgeLocoCommand
files.Summary: From Z21 FW version 1.43, a locomotive can be removed from the Z21 with the following command. This also cancels the sending of the loco commands for this locomotive on the track. Sending will start again as soon as a new drive or function command is sent to the same locomotive address.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.Driving.SetLocoDriveCommand
files.Summary: Change the speed and direction of a locomotive.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.Driving.SetLocoEStopCommand
files.Summary: From Z21 FW version 1.43, a locomotive can be stopped with the following command. In the case of a DCC locomotive, the speed step "E-STOP" ("emergency stop" according to RCN-212) is then sent in the DCC speed command onto the track, i.e., the decoder should stop the engine as quickly as possible. In the case of an MM locomotive, the speed step 0 ("Stop") is sent onto the track.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.Driving.SetLocoFunctionCommand
files.Summary: Change a function of a locomotive.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.Settings.GetAccessoryModeCommand
files.Summary: Read the settings for a given accessory decoder address ("Accessory Decoder" RP-9.2.1).

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.Settings.GetLocoModeCommand
files.Summary: Read the output format for a given locomotive address.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.Settings.SetAccessoryModeCommand
files.Summary: Set the output format for a given accessory decoder address. The format is stored in the Z21 persistently.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.Settings.SetLocoModeCommand
files.Summary: Set the output format for a given locomotive address. The format is stored in the Z21persistently.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.Switching.GetExtAccessoryInfoCommand
files.Summary: From Z21 FW V1. 40, the following request can be used to poll the last command transferred to an extended accessory decoder.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.Switching.GetTurnoutInfoCommand
files.Summary: The following command can be used to poll the status of a turnout (or any accessory function).

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.Switching.SetExtAccessoryCommand
files.Summary: From Z21 FW V1. 40, a DCC command in the "extended accessory decoder package format "(DCCext) can be sent to an extended accessory decoder with the following request. It allows to send even switching times for turnouts or complex signal aspects with just one single command

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.Switching.SetTurnoutCommand
files.Summary: A turnout (or any accessory function) can be switched with the following command.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.SystemState.GetBroadcastFlagsCommand
files.Summary: Reading the broadcast flags in the Z21.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.SystemState.GetFirmwareVersionCommand
files.Summary: The firmware version of the Z21 can be read with this command.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.SystemState.GetHardwareInfoCommand
files.Summary: Read the hardware type and the firmware version of the Z21.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.SystemState.GetSerialNumberCommand
files.Summary: Reading the serial number of the Z21.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.SystemState.GetSoftwareLockCommand
files.Summary: Read the software feature scope of the Z21 (and z21 or z21start of course).

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.SystemState.GetStatusCommand
files.Summary: This command can be used to request the Z21 status.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.SystemState.GetSystemStateDataCommand
files.Summary: Request the current system status.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.SystemState.GetVersionCommand
files.Summary: The X-Bus version of the Z21 can be read out with the following command.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.SystemState.LogOffCommand
files.Summary: Logging off the client from the Z21.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.SystemState.SetBroadcastFlagsCommand
files.Summary: Implements the LAN_SET_BROADCASTFLAGS command. See for some flags. See LAN_SET_BROADCASTFLAGS section of the Z21 lan protocol document for all possible flags.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.SystemState.TrackPower.SetStopCommand
files.Summary: With this command the emergency stop is activated, i.e. the locomotives are stopped but the track voltage remains switched on.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.SystemState.TrackPower.SetTrackPowerOffCommand
files.Summary: This command switches off the track voltage.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Command.SystemState.TrackPower.SetTrackPowerOnCommand
files.Summary: This command switches on the track voltage, or terminates either the emergency stop or the programming mode.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Model.Capabilities
files.Summary: Represents the supported capabilities of a Z21 device. Each property corresponds to a specific protocol feature.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Model.CentralState
files.Summary: Represents the current operational state of the Z21 central unit. Each property reflects a specific system condition or mode.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Model.CentralStateEx
files.Summary: Represents extended diagnostic states reported by the Z21 central unit. These flags provide additional system-level status information beyond the basic central state.

files.Title: Z21.Core.Model.ExcAccessoryPayload.SwitchDecoderPayload
files.Summary: The 10836 Z21 switch DECODER interprets the payload as "switch decoder with reception of switching time"

files.Title: Z21.Core.Model.SystemState
files.Summary: Represents the complete system status of the Z21 central unit, including electrical measurements, temperature, and operational flags.
